changes.comment: Default to listing branches when no action is specified.
Read local branches from Git metadata without subprocesses and add --other to list branches not checked out in each clone.
Add find --branch to locate clones containing an exact local branch, including branches that are not checked out.
Add remove --path or --alias to unregister a clone without deleting its files.
Group clones by common Git directory or matching remote URLs, sort aliases alphabetically, and warn about ambiguous grouping.
